mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity discount rates by lowering risk-free rates, directly increasing present value of future cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS decline >0.25pp in 3 months correlates with negative 20-day returns in >50% of cases over a 5-year rolling window, or Rank IC <0.03 for FEDFUNDS vs 20d returns.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.2pp monthly decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market tightening that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE decline >0.2pp in 1 month correlates with negative 20-day returns in >50% of cases over a 5-year rolling window, or Rank IC <0.03 for UNRATE change vs 20d returns.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in consumer credit demand (RSAFS) and falling interest rates (FEDFUNDS) indicate coordinated fiscal-monetary stimulus that accelerates consumer spending and corporate investment, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth >0.5% and FEDFUNDS decline >0.25pp correlates with negative 20-day returns in >50% of cases over a 5-year rolling window, or interaction term Rank IC <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a 0.5% monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing contraction that precedes earnings deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions (GDP growth >2% and UNRATE <4%), INDPRO decline >0.5% correlates with positive 20-day returns in >50% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust consumer confidence and construction activity, generating immediate positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days as markets react to new construction data.
failure_condition: HOUST >1250 correlates with negative 5-day returns in >50% of cases over a 5-year rolling window, or Rank IC <0.03 for HOUST vs 5d returns.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL rising >0.3pp in 3 months) signals imminent monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rise >0.3pp in 3 months correlates with positive 20-day returns in >50% of cases over a 5-year rolling window, or Rank IC >0.03 for CPI change vs 20d returns.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in employment (PAYEMS) and consumer credit demand (RSAFS) indicates strong labor market and consumption dynamics that drive positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days through earnings momentum.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth >0.3% and RSAFS growth >0.5% correlates with negative 20-day returns in >50% of cases over a 5-year rolling window, or interaction term Rank IC <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansions, quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2% signals sustained economic momentum that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days as market pricing adjusts to growth trajectory.
failure_condition: In early-cycle expansions (GDP growth >2% and UNRATE <4%), GDPC1 growth >2% correlates with negative 60-day returns in >50% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.
